status: Step 1 spec only; no clip authored yet. Owner approval required after review page.

game_contract.sim: Simulation.Stonehoof.cs: StonehoofTurnDegreesPerTick=6 at 30 ticks/s -> 90 deg in 15 ticks (0.5 s), constant angular speed
game_contract.view: CharacterAnimatorView.UpdateTurn: TurnPhase = Repeat(accumulated |yaw|, 90)/90 (1.0 at exact 90); TurnDirection = sign(delta); sign<0 -> LeftTurnState, else RightTurnState; crossfade 0.035 s from idle; state uses timeParameter=TurnPhase
game_contract.unity_builder: StonehoofBuilder.cs roles include optional TurnLeft/TurnRight; looks up clip name ending 'Stonehoof_TurnLeft'/'Stonehoof_TurnRight' in ForestStonehoof.fbx; skips state with warning if missing (falls back to Walk phase). loopTime not set for turns (phase driven), so frame 15 must equal frame 0 exactly.
game_contract.direction: Unity yaw delta < 0 = TurnLeft. Blender: model faces -Y, left side is +X, TurnLeft = +Z yaw (CCW seen from above), TurnRight = -Z yaw.

clip.loop: one 90 deg cycle; pose(0) == pose(15) in armature space
clip.root_yaw_deg: TurnLeft: +90*f/15, TurnRight: -90*f/15; LINEAR keys (sim angular speed is constant, phase is proportional to yaw)
clip.pivot: armature/object origin (0,0,0) = sim entity position; no translation of the root
clip.frame0: accepted stance = windup_start r01 frame 0 (same stance brake ends in, Idle hoof_key(tag,0)); all four hooves planted at f=0 and f=15; join check vs that stance (max joint error < 0.05 m allowed since the loop may carry small stance offsets; report it)

rig.source_file: animation/windup_start/Stonehoof_WindupStart_r01.blend (r03 model + editable IK controls; open it, clear animation like build_brake.py)
rig.hoof_bone: leg_<tag>_bot2 (sole = its >0.95-weight verts; sole_ids <sole_z+0.008 in windup_start/rig_build.json)
rig.rig_is_asymmetric: L/R bones are not mirror-exact; author Right as its own pass with mirrored PARAMETERS (per-leg offsets relative to each leg's own rest ankle), never by pose-bone mirroring

controls.carrier: CTRL_PreviewMotion_Only (arm and all CTRL_Hoof_*/CTRL_Pole_* parented to it); for turn: key rotation_euler.z / quaternion yaw here, preview only, excluded from bake
controls.hoof_targets: CTRL_Hoof_<tag> empties: location + rotation_quaternion + ['sole_clearance'] (float!) keyed via hoof_key()
controls.poles: CTRL_Pole_<tag>, children of carrier (rotate with body)
controls.ik: MCH_Lower_<tag> IK 'Hoof plant · fixed limb lengths' chain 2, use_stretch False, ik_stretch 0; MCH_Drive_* + COPY_TRANSFORMS 'Follow editable IK' on top1/bot0/bot1; COPY_ROTATION 'Hoof orientation' (WORLD) on bot2
controls.helpers_reuse: exec body_pose(frame,offset,pitch,roll,chest,neck,head,tail) and hoof_key(tag,frame,dy,dz,pitch,dx) from windup_start/build_clip.py via ast (as build_brake.py). body_pose has no yaw: add a small local helper spine_yaw(frame, body, chest, neck, head) composing Z-rotation in the same rest-space way.

planted_contact_method.principle: hoof targets are carrier children; a planted hoof keeps its WORLD position/orientation, so in carrier space it counter-rotates: loc(f)=Rz(-(yaw(f)-yaw_plant)) @ loc_plant, rot(f)=Rz(-(yaw(f)-yaw_plant)) @ rot_plant
planted_contact_method.keying: key planted hooves densely (every 1/4 frame, as build_brake sole-height resample) so bezier arcs do not chord-cut; swing keys BEZIER AUTO_CLAMPED; carrier yaw LINEAR
planted_contact_method.sole_height: after authoring, resample location.z from the rotated sole like build_brake.py (sole_z + sole_clearance - lowest rotated hoof vert) at 1/8 frame
planted_contact_method.geometry: per 90 deg each hoof must cover chord r*sqrt2 = 0.82 m (front) / 0.94 m (hind) in world -> about 2 steps per hoof per cycle (~45 deg each), 3-4 frame swings; front steps are lateral cross-steps, hind short pivot steps; reference hind 'pivot' cannot be literal because the sim pivot is the origin between the legs
planted_contact_method.style_from_reference: references/turn.mp4 (4.1 s, 24 fps, 1280x720; review_notes/jobs: use stepping pattern + head lead only; ignore drift and ~180 deg amount): head0/neck0 yaw lead of ~10-15 deg into the turn, chest (body_top0) shifts weight toward the outside, front cross-steps, hind small steps
planted_contact_method.loop_rule: hoof carrier-space trajectories periodic with period 15 (or 7.5 for 2 steps); all four planted at f=0/15; spine yaw lead identical at 0 and 15

files_to_create.brief: brief.json (stage, reference, contract, owner approval fields)
files_to_create.build: build_turn.py -- keys|all mode; builds both directions -> Stonehoof_Turn_r01.blend (editable master; actions AN_Stonehoof_TurnLeft_Rig / _TurnRight_Rig and per-hoof control actions; NLA or scenes per direction), writes build.json + pose_keys.json; renders review/animation_turn/{side,game,top}_frames
files_to_create.bake: bake_turn.py -- same as brake/bake_brake.py: sample deform bone pose matrices (armature space => root yaw removed, since arm is parented to carrier) at 1/16 frame, strip constraints, CTRL_* and non-deform bones, key loc+rot quaternion with sign continuity, BEZIER, actions AN_Stonehoof_TurnLeft and AN_Stonehoof_TurnRight (frame_range 0-15, use_frame_range) -> Stonehoof_Turn_Baked_r01.blend + bake_validation.json (assert joint error < 1 mm)
files_to_create.validate: validate_turn.py -> validation.json; validate_interpolation.py -> interpolation_validation.json; package_review.py + validate_review.py -> review/animation_turn/
files_to_create.unity_package_change: unity_package/build_package.py SOURCES += 'TurnLeft':('turn/Stonehoof_Turn_Baked_r01.blend','AN_Stonehoof_TurnLeft'), 'TurnRight':('turn/Stonehoof_Turn_Baked_r01.blend','AN_Stonehoof_TurnRight') -> exported as Stonehoof_TurnLeft/Right in ForestStonehoof.fbx (only after owner approval)

validator_checks.hoof_slip: while planted (sole_clearance==0), world sole centroid (evaluate r01 with carrier yaw; and baked: Rz(yaw(f)) @ armature-space sole) drift < 0.002 m; also horizontal sole yaw drift < 1 deg
validator_checks.hoof_target_error: ankle (bot2 head) vs CTRL_Hoof target < 0.001 m (IK reach)
validator_checks.ground: minimum mesh z > -0.001; planted sole min z within [-0.001, 0.007]
validator_checks.bone_lengths: max |posed length / rest length - 1| < 1e-4 for deform bones
validator_checks.loop_seam: armature-space deform matrices f0 vs f15: position < 1e-5 m, matrix error < 1e-4; also world continuity across seam when yaw is re-applied
validator_checks.stance_join: f0 vs windup_start r01 frame 0 deform pose (report; target < 0.05 m, used for idle crossfade)
validator_checks.constraints: every constraint influence explicitly keyed at f0 and f15 (=1), no un-keyed state leakage
validator_checks.rotation_step: max per-1/8-frame deform bone rotation step reported (pops)
validator_checks.bake: baked vs source joint error < 0.001 m, rotation < 2 deg at 1/32 frame; no scale curves; no object transform keys on ARM
validator_checks.sources_unchanged: sha256 of accepted blends (windup_start r01/Baked, charge_loop, brake, collision, death_r02) identical before/after
validator_checks.direction: sign check: TurnLeft carrier yaw +Z; head0 tail moves toward +X at f=7.5
